title: Signed ordered refinement maps between specified augmented rows
statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion] with quasi-compact complementary open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and let $A$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For every ordered positive finite closed family $F$ over $i$, suppose a signed row $R_F$ with its specified unit-normalized restrictions, terms, augmentation and support has already been supplied [def-sfb-signed-closed-row-data].

There is a simultaneous collection of the following row-level maps. Given families $F,G$ of lengths m,n, a function $f:\operatorname{Fin}(n)\to\operatorname{Fin}(m)$, and nonempty factorizations $G_b\to F_{f(b)}$ over X, there are natural mixed restrictions $c_{s,t}:E_{F_s}\to E_{G_t}$ for every pair of subsets. For $s\subseteq f(t)$ they obey $\eta_{F_s}c_{s,t}=\eta_{G_t}$. There is a natural chain map $\rho_f:R_F\to R_G$. Under the specified term isomorphisms in each nonnegative degree p, its output component at an increasing (p+1)-tuple t is the sum over increasing source tuples s of $\epsilon_f(s,t)c_{\operatorname{im}s,\operatorname{im}t}\pi_s$, where $\epsilon_f(s,t)$ is the sum of the signs of all permutations sigma satisfying $s(\sigma k)=f(tk)$. This is zero for repeated image tuples, and otherwise precisely the sorting-permutation sign from the unique source image tuple. These are the existing finite ordered term and matrix formulas [def-sfb-finite-closed-row-constructions]. Moreover $\alpha_F\rho_f=\alpha_G$, $\rho_{\mathrm{id}}=1$, and $\rho_f\rho_g=\rho_{f\circ g}$ for every composable pair of refinement functions and supplied factorizations. This assertion is about row chain maps only: it constructs neither rows nor any maps between their totals.

proof.text: For s contained in f(t), the supplied member factorizations and finite product projections give the arrow from the target t-intersection into the source s-intersection. Push its actual unit to X and identify the composite inverse images by the normalized composition comparison. Put zero for invalid pairs. The composition-unit equation and uniqueness of conjugate comparisons give mixed_unit and all compatibilities with successive restrictions.

proof.text: The normalized unit at each closed intersection is epimorphic by open-closed localization: complements are finite unions of the given quasi-compact opens. Transport the epimorphic unit across the unique unit-compatible comparison of adjunctions. Precomposition with this unit then shows that the given row restrictions agree with the actual ones used in the calculation. The same argument handles the given maps from Z and singleton augmentations.

proof.text: Transport the signed finite matrix through the specified term isomorphisms. On an injective image tuple use the deleted-face permutation sign identity to identify each term in the chain equation after sorting. On a noninjective tuple there are either no injective faces or exactly two obtained by deleting a single repeated pair. The two latter faces have the same image set and same restriction, and the transposition form of the deleted-face identity makes their signed coefficients negatives, so they cancel in every characteristic. Zero objects handle degrees outside the supports. Naturality gives the natural transformation of row functors.

proof.text: In degree zero the sorting permutation is the identity, so composition of actual units proves the augmentation equation componentwise. In other degrees the source single complex is zero. Identity refinements give the identity matrix. For composition, repeated images give zero on both sides; otherwise the sorting permutation signs multiply, and the unit comparisons compose to the direct restriction. Product projections, the given term isomorphisms and support identify the natural chain maps and prove strict identity and composition.
